characterization: This person browses far more than they cook — two to four recipes opened and dismissed in a sitting, roughly twice a week, with an actual cook about every two weeks. Every single dish they finished uses weight or pressing to do the work: chicken under a brick, weighted cabbage, flattened quail, pressed pork belly. They stalled on the brick chicken mid-cook early on, then came back two months later, read the technique note again, and finished it. The dishes they open most and never make — cacio e pepe, the green sauce, anchovy butter — are the ones where you have to judge an emulsion by feel with nothing holding the food down.
salientInference: Across ninety days you only finished dishes where weight does the work; the emulsions you reopen ask you to judge by feel.

signals.rhythm: Long browsing stretches, one committed cook roughly every other week, almost always midweek
